title: Paloma Business Account Points on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credits
content:
Cross-product benefit table: a customer's **Paloma Business** account earns points on a **Mobile Wallet** re-credit after money went to the wrong wallet.

| The customer's Paloma Business account | Business points |
|---|---|
| active, on Paloma Business Growth, Paloma Business Pro, Paloma Business Scale or Paloma Business Enterprise | 0.20 |
| active, on Paloma Business Starter or Paloma Business Essentials | 0.10 |
| no Paloma Business account, or an account that is not active | nothing |

Both the account's status and its plan are read from the customer's Paloma Business account record.

*Hypothetical cases:* an active account on Paloma Business Pro earns 0.20; an active account on Paloma Business Essentials earns 0.10; an account on Paloma Business Enterprise whose status is not active earns nothing.
